Subject: RetailFlux discovery — next step: exec intro + deep-dive

Irene / Mateo,

Thanks again for the call earlier — helpful to see how Redwood approaches inference economics. Quick recap from our side and a clear ask to keep momentum:

- Need an exec handshake (VP of Eng or CTO) to unblock internal approval for a pilot.
- Post-exec, we expect a 60m technical deep-dive with infra and security folks to scope the pilot.
- Primary constraints: data residency questions, latency baseline, and cost-per-req targets.

Can we lock a 30m VP/CTO intro + a separate 60m infra deep-dive next week? Our leadership is available:
- Tue 2028-09-05 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 2028-09-06 13:00–16:00 PT

Attendees from RetailFlux: Samira Khan (Head of Data Platforms), myself (Tom, Head of Product). We can extend if the CTO wants additional engineers.

I've attached our mutual action plan (MAP) with key success criteria so you can tailor the deep-dive.

Thanks — looking to lock windows so procurement can start the vendor evaluation.

—Tom
Tom Nguyen
Head of Product, RetailFlux

Tom — really appreciate the clear ask and the MAP. Happy to drive this.

Proposed approach:
- 30m VP/CTO handshake (goal: align exec success metrics and decision timeline)
- 60m infra deep-dive with SE + infra owners (goal: validate latency/cost assumptions and data residency plan)

I can offer these concrete slots from our side:
- Tue 2028-09-05 09:30–11:00 PT (we can do VP intro at 10:00 and infra deep-dive at 10:30 if you want to combine)
- Wed 2028-09-06 14:00–15:30 PT (separate sessions ok)

Please confirm whether RetailFlux prefers a combined 90m session or two separate touchpoints. If separate, what slot do you prefer for the 30m exec intro? Once you confirm, I'll invite Redwood's CTO backup (Karthik) and Mateo as SE.

I'm attaching a slim pre-demo checklist so the deep-dive can be focused. Also adding a short agenda below:
- VP/CTO handshake: objectives, pilot gating criteria, timeline, procurement ask (15m)
- Infra deep-dive: current infra topology, expected QPS and sizing, KV cache/prefixing approach, quantization tradeoffs (45–60m)

—Irene

- 0–10m: state-of-play and pilot goals (Tom / Samira)
- 10–30m: infra topology + traffic profile (RetailFlux infra lead)

- 50–60m: next steps and pilot gating checklist

Pre-demo asks (attachments):
- sample API traffic profile (QPS, avg tokens, peak windows)
- dataset residency constraints and retention policy
- basic network diagram and egress constraints

Availability: Tue 9/5 09:30–12:00 PT or Wed 9/6 13:30–15:30 PT. I can also bring logs/benchmarks examples if you share typical seq length and token rates ahead of time.

Attaching: pre-demo-checklist.xlsx and RetailFlux-MAP-v1.pdf (from Tom).
